review.images: Reviewed the wide hero and all nine official Farm Grove gallery assets. Used the daylight street elevation for the listing card. Pool renders are illustrative of the design. Original standalone drawings qualify provision.
review.location: Matched the named developer point. Visually verified the map on physical brochure page 4 and the four estimates on page 4. Regional map in the Emaar Farm Grove brochure. The Blue Line is shown as future.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all 11 physical pages and retained all ten residence sheets. The official pack separates standalone, semi-detached and other villa types. Checked all imperial totals within 0.01 sq ft. The standalone sheets mark the pool as excluded.

unavailable: Signed unit-specific areas and individual entrance coordinates were not verified.
